items.title: Netflix layoffs: 1,000 jobs to go as streaming giant expands into ads, live sports and gaming
items.summary: Netflix layoffs: Netflix is reportedly planning to cut about 6% of its workforce, or roughly 1,000 jobs, in its biggest round of layoffs since 2022. The reported cuts come as the streaming company expands into advertising, live programming and gaming amid intensifying competition for viewers.

items.title: Record oil tanker rates put pressure on Asian refiners, IEA says
items.summary: Asian oil refiners are facing increased shipping costs that are significantly affecting their profit margins. The cost of transporting oil via supertankers from the Middle East has surged sharply, leading to higher delivery prices. As a result, many refiners have seen their processing margins turn negative in recent months. Although refiners can buy US crude, shipping rates have also risen considerably for these imports.

items.title: Global Market: BoE's Huw Pill wary of market bets on four rate hikes over next year
items.summary: Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill has questioned market expectations for four quarter-point rate hikes over the next 12 months as policymakers assess the inflationary fallout of the Iran war. His comments highlight divisions within the Monetary Policy Committee over how to balance rising energy prices against risks to economic growth.

Follow this live blog for the latest results, key financial highlights and stock movements as companies announce their earnings.

items.title: Airbus forecasts huge hiring gap as aviation services market expands
items.summary: Airbus projects a need for 2.44 million personnel in aviation, including pilots and maintenance staff. This forecast highlights challenges in recruitment after the COVID-19 pandemic affected workforce availability. The company aims to significantly increase service revenue to over $10 billion by 2030. Growth in commercial services is expected to average 3.8% annually, doubling the market size by 2045. Airlines are increasingly prioritizing data connectivity as a key service component.

items.title: US yields jump as hot consumer inflation boosts rate hike bets
items.summary: In September, the US Treasury yields climbed as the Consumer Price Index (CPI) showed a surprising rise of 0.6% month-over-month and 3.7% year-over-year. This unexpected inflation report heightened the chances of an interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve in December, signaling a potential response to ongoing inflationary pressures. Market sentiments are now leaning toward the anticipation of policy changes from the Fed as they aim to manage inflation effectively.

items.title: Jio’s 10-year timeline: How Ambani's Reliance transformed Indian telecom
items.summary: Reliance Jio has dramatically altered India's telecom industry since its launch in 2016 with affordable services. This transformation included a price war that changed mobile data consumption patterns across the country. Jio has expanded from basic connectivity to include 5G and various digital services. The company's partnerships with major tech firms have broadened its market reach and offerings.

items.title: Centre set to cross Rs 80000 cr disinvestment target for first time since FY19 after IDBI Bank stake sale
items.summary: The Indian government is expected to surpass its budgeted disinvestment target of Rs 80,000 crore for FY27. A significant contributor will be the strategic sale of IDBI Bank, which is valued at over Rs 52,878 crore. This sale includes the government's 30.48% stake alongside LIC's 30.24% stake in the bank. The total proceeds from various minority stake sales have already reached Rs 55,757 crore.

The quota offers RIL investors a direct route to apply for Jio Platforms shares. The IPO opens on October 21, with anchor investor bidding starting October 19.

items.summary: Wall Street's major indices took a hit as an inflation report outpaced forecasts, sparking heightened speculation about rate increases. Investors are closely reviewing earnings from key banks, highlighting concerns over escalating inflation. The notable market fluctuations suggest a likelihood of rising interest rates as the economy continues to be assessed.

items.summary: Learner drivers in September had to wait an average of 19.7 weeks, or around five months, for a practical test.

items.summary: To fortify its electrical manufacturing division, Lord's Mark Industries Limited has successfully acquired Radio Electric Private Limited. This acquisition brings a wealth of expertise and strong customer ties into the fold. The company is set to enhance its operational scale and venture into new markets. Existing operations will be upheld under familiar management, as Lord's Mark Industries Limited crafts a comprehensive growth strategy to broaden its reach.

items.summary: US consumer prices increased in September, contributing to expectations of an interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve. Market predictions indicate a 44% chance of a rate hike in October and a 95% chance in December.

items.title: India's electricity demand set to outpace overall energy demand by 2035; data centres to fuel growth: S&P Global
items.summary: India's electricity demand is projected to increase as industries move towards electric and hydrogen-based processes. This growth in demand is spurred by rising incomes, industrialization, and increased cooling requirements. Data centres and green hydrogen production will significantly contribute to this rising electricity consumption. Additionally, distributed generation is anticipated to meet an increasing share of electricity needs. The power infrastructure will need to evolve to manage this growing demand effectively.

items.title: Reliance Jio files RHP, announces IPO dates for India's biggest listing
items.summary: Jio IPO: Reliance Jio has filed its red herring prospectus for an October 21-23 IPO, set to be India’s biggest public issue. The offering comprises 27 crore fresh shares, with reservations for Reliance Industries shareholders and employees. The company plans to use most of the proceeds to repay borrowings, while investors assess its valuation.

items.title: Bajaj Consumer Care Q2 Results: Profit jumps 66% YoY to Rs 70 crore, revenue rises 25%
items.summary: Bajaj Consumer Care reported a 66% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 70.2 crore, while operating income grew 25.4% to Rs 332.8 crore. EBITDA surged 71% to Rs 83.3 crore. Domestic business revenue grew over 30%, and the company’s shares have rallied 96.42% in 2026 so far.

items.title: Toyota Kirloskar Motor to ramp up capacity at Karnataka plant from early 2027
items.summary: Toyota Kirloskar Motor plans to expand production capacity at its Bidadi facility in Karnataka from early next year. The expansion aims to decrease waiting periods for specific models while preparing for new vehicle launches. Additionally, the company is establishing a new plant in Maharashtra with a similar production capacity of 1 lakh units. The automaker recently launched the facelifted Glanza hatchback to meet ongoing demand.

items.title: India homecoming: The Hyderabad-born man behind Fairfax, the Canadian powerhouse that has bought IDBI
items.summary: Prem Watsa, who moved from Hyderabad to Canada at 22 with $8, built Fairfax Financial into a global insurance and investment group. Now valued at around $100 billion in assets, Fairfax is expanding its India presence through the acquisition of IDBI Bank.

items.title: IDBI Bank strategic restructuring to attract FDI, boost banking sector, says FM Sitharaman
items.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved the strategic restructuring of IDBI Bank to attract foreign investments. The government retains a minority stake in the bank after its recovery, enabling further growth. Fairfax Financial Holdings will acquire a 60.72 percent stake in the bank for Rs 52,878 crore. The transaction aims to strengthen India's banking sector and reduce government ownership of state-run assets.

items.title: Crude oil prices above $100 a barrel: Why HPCL, IOCL and BPCL could face earnings pressure, experts decode
items.summary: Crude prices above $100 a barrel could squeeze Indian state-run oil marketers’ margins if petrol and diesel prices remain unchanged. HPCL faces the greatest earnings pressure, followed by IOC and BPCL.

items.title: Cabinet approves 78 days productivity linked bonus to railway staffers
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a Productivity Linked Bonus for over 1.1 million railway employees. This bonus, amounting to Rs 2009.61 crore, recognizes the staff's excellent performance. Eligible railway employees will receive payments before the upcoming Durga Puja and Dusshera holidays. The maximum payable amount to each employee is Rs 17,951 for a duration of 78 days. This initiative aims to motivate railway staff towards continued improvements in their performance.

items.title: IDBI Bank-Fairfax deal: Government to retain 15% stake, LIC to hold 19%
items.summary: The government will retain a 15% equity stake in IDBI Bank and Life Insurance Corporation will hold 19%. Both the government and LIC will withdraw their nominees from the bank's board and become public shareholders. The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs has empowered the Alternative Mechanism for minority stake sales of the government's holdings. LIC will manage its residual shareholding as per internal procedures and regulatory compliance.

items.title: India bonds sink deeper on RBI commentary, inflation concerns
items.summary: Indian government bonds are currently facing notable losses, pushing the 10-year yield to its highest since March 2023. This downturn comes in the wake of hawkish remarks from Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra about financial stability. Additionally, India's wholesale inflation saw an unexpected rise in September, leading to growing concerns over potential future monetary policy shifts.

items.title: Cabinet clears Rs 53,428 crore for social assistance scheme, revises disability pension norms
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved an outlay of Rs 53,428 crore for the National Social Assistance Programme. This approval will support the program's continuation from 2026-27 to 2030-31 with updated eligibility criteria. Monthly assistance rates for disability pension beneficiaries will increase with adjustments for age and disability severity.

items.title: India's alternative accommodation market expected to reach $4.7 billion in GBV by FY29: Report
items.summary: India’s alternative accommodation market is projected to grow to $4.7 billion in gross booking value by FY29 from $2.6 billion in FY26, according to a Booking.com and VIDEC Consultants report. Digitally distributed listings crossed 200,000 in FY26, with tier-two cities, religious centres and emerging leisure destinations driving expansion.

items.title: Global oil demand to fall by 2.6 million barrels per day in 2026, diesel to account for 25 pc of decline: IEA
items.summary: Global oil demand is anticipated to decrease significantly in 2026 due to the impact of the Iran war. Diesel is expected to account for 25 percent of this decline in demand. Oil supply is projected to rise temporarily before experiencing a drop in 2026, complicating market conditions. Additionally, refinery margins are under pressure from higher crude costs, affecting global output.

items.title: Hyundai Motor India to invest Rs 11,000 crore at Pune plant
items.summary: Hyundai Motor India announced plans to invest Rs 11,000 crore at its Pune facility in phases. This investment aims to expand manufacturing capacity and enhance industrial development in the region. The Pune plant currently has an annual capacity of 170,000 units, which will increase to 320,000 by 2030. This investment follows Hyundai's earlier commitment of $15.5 billion for a comprehensive strategy over seven years.

items.title: Government mulls further tightening of FDI norms in tobacco sector: Sources
items.summary: The Indian government is evaluating a proposal to restrict foreign direct investment in the tobacco sector. This initiative aims to tighten FDI regulations related to licenses, trademarks, and management contracts. Previous efforts to enhance these norms faced challenges from tobacco farmers' associations. The proposal is crucial as India aims to comply with the World Health Organization's regulations on tobacco control.

items.title: Leela reports operating revenue of Rs 412 cr in Q2FY27, PAT at Rs 95 cr
